citations.quote: only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent
Would activities that an RA 13 depositary performs in its capacity as a Transfer Agent (TA) (eg, processing payments in designated accounts) be subject to requirements under the CMR?

In such cases, the depositary is expected to observe relevant requirements under Schedule 11 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Schedule 11), in particular paragraphs 9 (relating to how subscription and redemption proceeds should be held) and 11 (relating to distribution proceeds).

readings.distinction: Activity-specific attachment: “not” negates acting in the Transfer Agent capacity for the transaction under assessment. This reading is preferred because Q1 expressly asks about activities performed in that capacity. The rival entity-wide reading remains possible because the answer refers to “such LC” without expressly repeating the activity limitation.

citations.quote: The CMR will apply to an RA 13 licensed corporation (LC) and its associated entity (AE) in respect of “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong by the RA 13 LC or its AE in the course of conducting Type 13 regulated activity by the RA 13 LC, only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent.
That said, in the context of RA 13, handling of money which is not “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong will not be subject to the CMR.

readings.distinction: Entity-wide attachment: the final qualification concerns the LC as an actor, rather than its capacity for a particular transaction. An LC concurrently performing unrelated Transfer Agent work would fail this antecedent even for otherwise qualifying depositary money. The wording permits this reading, although the activity-specific framing of Q1 weighs against it.

vocabulary_concerns: transfer_agent has no transaction, capacity or time index. The first formalization therefore depends on an explicit activity-specific input assumption; encoding the entity-wide rival with the same symbol would conceal the disputed distinction.

ra13_context combines actor identity and the course-of-RA13 relationship. It cannot separately test whether the LC or AE holds the money while preserving the qualification’s express reference to the LC.
The incorporated definition of scheme money is unavailable. scheme_money remains an externally supplied classification, not a definition established by this predicate.

The Schedule 11 sentence expressly addresses “such cases” following the non-scheme-money statement. The supplied text does not settle whether it also covers every Transfer Agent exclusion. No declared fact represents those duties or their satisfaction.

Q2’s general timing rule and unknown-receipt qualification may affect when scheme_money can be supplied as true, but the vocabulary cannot represent changing classification or unknown-receipt evidence. They should not silently become additional Q1 conjuncts.
